q: India's first 20-coach Vande Bharat Express, introduced in September 2024, was put into service on the route between New Delhi and:
e: India's first 20-coach Vande Bharat Express, introduced in September 2024 to meet heavy demand on the busy route, was put into service between New Delhi and Varanasi.

q: With the inauguration of the Sahibabad-New Ashok Nagar section in January 2025, the Namo Bharat trains of the Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS) entered Delhi for the first time. This corridor connects Delhi with:
e: The Delhi-Meerut Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS), branded Namo Bharat, entered Delhi in January 2025 with the inauguration of the Sahibabad-New Ashok Nagar section, connecting Delhi with Meerut.

q: The specially designed Vande Bharat Express, built to operate in the harsh winter conditions of the Kashmir Valley, completed its trial run in January 2025 from Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra to:
e: The specially designed Vande Bharat Express for the Kashmir Valley, fitted with heating systems, heated windshields and other winter features, completed its trial run in January 2025 from Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra to Srinagar.

q: Commercial services on India's first underwater metro section, passing beneath the Hooghly river, commenced in March 2024 in Kolkata between Howrah Maidan and:
e: Commercial services on India's first underwater metro section, which passes through a tunnel beneath the Hooghly river, began in March 2024 in Kolkata between Howrah Maidan and Esplanade.

q: The Railways (Amendment) Act, 2025, enacted in March 2025, repealed which earlier Act relating to the Railway Board and subsumed its provisions into the Railways Act, 1989?
e: The Railways (Amendment) Act, 2025 repealed the Indian Railway Board Act, 1905 and subsumed the statutory provisions relating to the Railway Board into the Railways Act, 1989.

q: The Indian Port Rail and Ropeway Corporation Limited (IPRCL), set up to provide efficient rail evacuation systems to the major ports, is a joint venture of Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) with:

options.A: The National Highways Authority of India
options.B: Eleven major ports under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
options.C: The Container Corporation of India Limited
options.D: The Inland Waterways Authority of India

e: Indian Port Rail and Ropeway Corporation Limited (IPRCL) is a joint venture of Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) with eleven major ports under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, formed to provide rail evacuation systems to ports.

q: The Chhattisgarh East West Railway Limited (CEWRL), a joint venture involving South Eastern Coalfields Limited and IRCON, is executing the East-West Rail Corridor in Chhattisgarh between:
e: Chhattisgarh East West Railway Limited (CEWRL), the joint venture of SECL, IRCON and the Chhattisgarh Government, is executing the East-West Rail Corridor from Gevra Road to Pendra Road for coal evacuation from the Korba region.

q: The Odisha Rail Infrastructure Development Limited (ORIDL), an umbrella joint venture company floated for fast-track development of railway projects through project-specific special purpose vehicles, is a joint venture of the Ministry of Railways with the Government of:
e: Odisha Rail Infrastructure Development Limited (ORIDL) is a joint venture of the Ministry of Railways with the Government of Odisha, floated to fast-track railway projects in the State through project-specific SPVs.

q: The Bastar Railway Private Limited (BRPL), a joint venture of NMDC, SAIL, IRCON and the Chhattisgarh Mineral Development Corporation, was incorporated for developing which new rail line project in Chhattisgarh?
e: Bastar Railway Private Limited (BRPL), promoted by NMDC, SAIL, IRCON and the Chhattisgarh Mineral Development Corporation, was incorporated to develop the Rowghat to Jagdalpur new rail line in Chhattisgarh.

q: The capital gain bonds issued by the Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) under Section 54EC of the Income Tax Act provide tax exemption on long-term capital gains arising from the sale of:

options.A: Equity shares and mutual fund units

e: IRFC's 54EC capital gain bonds give exemption from tax on long-term capital gains invested in them, and such gains under Section 54EC of the Income Tax Act arise from the transfer of land or building.

q: The Commission of Railway Safety, which carries out inspectorial, investigatory and advisory functions relating to the safety of rail travel under the Railways Act, 1989, works under the administrative control of the:

options.D: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

e: The Commission of Railway Safety, which inspects new lines, investigates serious rail accidents and advises on safety matters under the Railways Act, 1989, works under the administrative control of the Ministry of Civil Aviation to keep it independent of the Railways.

q: CONCOR Air Limited, which was set up to develop capabilities in the air cargo and logistics sector and to complement multimodal logistics offerings, is a wholly owned subsidiary of:

options.D: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited

e: CONCOR Air Limited, which develops air cargo and logistics capabilities to complement the container business, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR).

q: The Multi-Functional Complexes (MFCs) developed by the Rail Land Development Authority (RLDA) at railway stations mainly provide, under one roof:

options.C: Crew rest rooms and running rooms
options.D: Shopping, food stalls, ATMs, budget hotels and other passenger amenities

e: Multi-Functional Complexes (MFCs) developed by the Rail Land Development Authority (RLDA) at stations provide shopping, food stalls, ATMs, budget hotels and other passenger amenities under one roof on railway land near the station.

q: The joint venture company formed by the Government of Andhra Pradesh with Indian Railways for taking up major rail projects in the State was set up mainly to:

options.A: Operate suburban train services in Vijayawada
options.B: Take up new railway lines and develop railway stations in Andhra Pradesh
options.C: Manufacture coaches and wagons in Andhra Pradesh
options.D: Run container terminals at the ports of Andhra Pradesh

e: The joint venture company formed by the Government of Andhra Pradesh with Indian Railways was set up to take up new railway lines, doubling and other major rail projects and develop railway stations in Andhra Pradesh on a cost-sharing basis.

q: The Indian Railways Institute of Civil Engineering (IRICEN) at Pune mainly imparts training to the officers and supervisors of which department of Indian Railways?
e: The Indian Railways Institute of Civil Engineering (IRICEN) at Pune is the centralised training institute that imparts training to officers and supervisors of the Civil Engineering Department, covering track, bridges and works.

q: The Pune-Nashik Semi High-Speed Rail Corridor in Maharashtra is being executed by the Maharashtra Rail Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited (MRIDC), a joint venture of the Government of Maharashtra and the Ministry of Railways. The corridor will connect Pune with:
e: The Pune-Nashik Semi High-Speed Rail Corridor, being executed by Maharashtra Rail Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited (MRIDC or MahaRail), will connect Pune with Nashik in Maharashtra.

q: India's first railway station redeveloped under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, in collaboration with the Indian Railway Stations Development Corporation (IRSDC), was the:

options.B: Habibganj station (now Rani Kamalapati) at Bhopal

e: Habibganj station at Bhopal, now renamed Rani Kamalapati station, was India's first railway station redeveloped under the PPP model in collaboration with the Indian Railway Stations Development Corporation (IRSDC).

q: The Railway Claims Tribunal, constituted under the Railway Claims Tribunal Act, 1987, mainly adjudicates claims relating to:

options.A: Promotion and seniority disputes of railway employees
options.B: Fixation of freight rates for goods traffic
options.C: Compensation for death or injury in railway accidents and loss of goods entrusted to the Railways
options.D: Approval of new railway lines and doubling projects

e: The Railway Claims Tribunal, set up under the Railway Claims Tribunal Act, 1987, adjudicates claims for compensation for death or injury in railway accidents and untoward incidents and for loss or damage of goods entrusted to the Railways.

q: The Tindharia Workshop, described as the only workshop in the world carrying out regular maintenance and repair of two-feet narrow gauge steam locomotives, maintains the rolling stock of the:
e: The Tindharia Workshop in the Darjeeling hills carries out regular maintenance and repair of the two-feet narrow gauge steam locomotives of the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, a UNESCO World Heritage railway.

q: The ancillary unit of the Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, set up for the manufacture of locomotive components and assemblies, is located at:
e: The ancillary unit of Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW), set up at Dankuni in West Bengal for manufacture of locomotive components and assemblies, supplements the main CLW plant at Chittaranjan.

q: The Jamalpur Workshop of Eastern Railway, one of the oldest workshops of Indian Railways, is well known for the manufacture of:

options.C: Railway cranes and heavy lifting jacks

e: The Jamalpur Workshop of Eastern Railway in Bihar, established in 1862 and among the oldest railway workshops in India, is well known for manufacturing railway cranes and heavy lifting jacks.

q: The EMU Workshop at Tambaram, which undertakes the periodic overhaul of the electric multiple unit rakes of the Chennai suburban network, functions under the:
e: The EMU Workshop at Tambaram in Chennai, which undertakes periodic overhaul of the electric multiple unit rakes of the Chennai suburban network, functions under Southern Railway.

q: The Kharagpur Workshop of South Eastern Railway is distinctive among the major workshops of Indian Railways because it undertakes periodic overhaul of:
e: The Kharagpur Workshop of South Eastern Railway is distinctive because, unlike most workshops specialising in one type of stock, it undertakes periodic overhaul of coaches, wagons and locomotives alike.

q: The railway workshop at Samastipur in Bihar is mainly engaged in the repair and periodic overhaul of:
e: The railway workshop at Samastipur in Bihar is mainly engaged in the repair and periodic overhaul of wagons for East Central Railway.

q: Which division of Indian Railways has consistently recorded the highest freight loading and freight revenue earnings among all railway divisions of the country in recent years?
e: Dhanbad division of East Central Railway, serving the coalfields of Jharkhand and Bengal, has consistently recorded the highest freight loading and freight revenue earnings among all railway divisions of the country.

q: Nagpur is a curiosity on the railway map of India because the city is the headquarters of two railway divisions bearing the same name, Nagpur division, which function under the:

options.A: Western Railway and West Central Railway
options.B: Central Railway and South Central Railway
options.C: South Eastern Railway and East Central Railway
options.D: Central Railway and South East Central Railway

e: Nagpur has two divisions of the same name because one Nagpur division functions under Central Railway and the other Nagpur division functions under South East Central Railway.

q: The headquarters of the Sonpur division of East Central Railway, where the headquarters of the zonal railway itself is also located, is at:
e: The headquarters of the Sonpur division of East Central Railway is at Hajipur in Bihar, which is also the headquarters of the East Central Railway zone itself.

q: The headquarters of the Hyderabad division of South Central Railway is not located at Hyderabad itself, but at:
e: The headquarters of the Hyderabad division of South Central Railway is located at Secunderabad, the twin city where the South Central Railway headquarters is also situated, and not at Hyderabad itself.

q: The Chakradharpur division of South Eastern Railway is best known for handling heavy originating traffic of:

options.A: Food grains from the Punjab region
options.B: Tea from the gardens of Assam
options.C: Iron ore and other minerals from the mines of Jharkhand and Odisha
options.D: Automobiles from the factories of Haryana

e: The Chakradharpur division of South Eastern Railway is best known for handling heavy originating traffic of iron ore and other minerals from the mines of Jharkhand and Odisha, besides steel plant traffic.

q: In the classification of railway expenditure, the fund denoted by 'DF', which is credited with amounts for works such as staff quarters, passenger amenities and track machines beyond the scope of other funds, stands for:
e: DF stands for Development Fund, the railway fund credited with amounts to finance works such as staff quarters, passenger amenities and track machines that fall outside the scope of the other funds.

q: In railway finance, the fund denoted by 'CF', which was created to finance works of a capital nature when the Capital (loan) account was closed, stands for:
e: CF stands for Capital Fund, created in railway finance to finance works of a capital nature after the Capital (loan) account was closed following the separation conventions.

q: In railway budgeting, the abbreviation 'GBS', denoting the budgetary support provided by the Central Government to Indian Railways for its capital expenditure, stands for:
e: GBS stands for Gross Budgetary Support, the funds provided by the Central Government from the general budget to Indian Railways to meet its capital expenditure.

q: In railway financing, the abbreviation 'IEBR', denoting the resources raised by Indian Railways from internal generation and market borrowings to supplement budgetary support, stands for:
e: IEBR stands for Internal and Extra Budgetary Resources, the resources Indian Railways raises through its internal generation and market borrowings, including through IRFC, to supplement Gross Budgetary Support.

q: In Government accounts organisation, the officer denoted by 'PAO', who is responsible for payment and accounting functions in respect of a Ministry or Department, stands for:
e: PAO stands for Pay and Accounts Office, the office responsible for payment and accounting functions in respect of a Ministry or Department in the Government accounts organisation.

q: In railway establishment rules, the allowance denoted by 'HRA', admissible to an employee who is not provided with Government accommodation, stands for:
e: HRA stands for House Rent Allowance, the allowance paid to a Government employee who is not provided with Government residential accommodation to meet the cost of rented housing.

q: In railway leave rules, the leave denoted by 'EOL', which is granted when no other leave is admissible and which generally does not count for increment, stands for:
e: EOL stands for Extra Ordinary Leave, granted when no other leave is admissible to the employee; it generally does not count for increment except in specified cases.

q: In railway leave rules, the leave denoted by 'LND', which may be granted to a permanent employee when no other leave is due, stands for:
e: LND stands for Leave Not Due, leave that may be granted to a permanent employee, on medical certificate or for specified studies, when no other leave is due to him, against leave he will earn later.

q: In personnel management on Indian Railways, the appraisal document denoted by 'APAR', in which the performance of an employee is assessed every year, stands for:

options.C: Assessment of Promotion and Advancement Record

e: APAR stands for Annual Performance Appraisal Report, the document in which the performance of a Government employee is assessed and recorded every year.

q: In railway establishment matters, the body denoted by 'DPC', which considers eligible employees for promotion to selection posts, stands for:
e: DPC stands for Departmental Promotion Committee, the body that considers and recommends eligible employees for promotion to selection posts.

q: In railway stores and works procurement, the e-procurement portal denoted by 'IREPS', through which tenders are invited and processed online, stands for:

options.C: Internal Review of Estimates and Purchase System

e: IREPS stands for Indian Railways E-Procurement System, the official e-procurement portal through which Indian Railways invites and processes tenders for stores, works and services online.

q: Mizoram's first Rajdhani Express, flagged off in September 2025 from Sairang near Aizawl, connects Sairang with which terminal in Delhi?
e: Mizoram's first Rajdhani Express, train numbers 20507 and 20508 flagged off in September 2025 after the opening of the Bairabi-Sairang line, connects Sairang near Aizawl with Anand Vihar Terminal in Delhi.

q: In January 2026, the Prime Minister flagged off a batch of new Amrit Bharat Express trains from West Bengal and Assam over a single weekend. The number of new Amrit Bharat Express trains flagged off on that occasion was:
e: In January 2026 the Prime Minister flagged off nine new Amrit Bharat Express trains from West Bengal and Assam over a single weekend, including services from Kamakhya, Dibrugarh, New Jalpaiguri, Alipurduar and Kolkata.

q: One of the Amrit Bharat Express trains flagged off in January 2026 connects Kamakhya (Guwahati) with Rohtak, which is located in the State of:
e: Rohtak, the destination of the Kamakhya-Rohtak Amrit Bharat Express flagged off in January 2026, is a city in Haryana, so the train connects Assam with Haryana.

q: For the Diwali and Chhath festive rush of 2025, Indian Railways operated special trains across the country during the period from 1st October to 30th November 2025 numbering more than:
e: For the Diwali and Chhath festive rush, Indian Railways scheduled more than 12,000 special trains across the country during 1 October to 30 November 2025, against 7,724 such trains the previous year.

q: The Ernakulam-KSR Bengaluru Vande Bharat Express, flagged off in November 2025, was described by Southern Railway as the first inter-state semi-high-speed train service linking the three States of:

options.C: Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh

e: The Ernakulam-KSR Bengaluru Vande Bharat Express, flagged off in November 2025, was described by Southern Railway as the first inter-state semi-high-speed service linking Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka, as the route passes through all three States.

q: As per the Press Information Bureau, the total freight loading achieved by Indian Railways during the financial year 2025-26, a new record, was:
e: As per the Press Information Bureau, Indian Railways achieved record total freight loading of 1,670 million tonnes during the financial year 2025-26.

q: As per the Press Information Bureau, the number of locomotives produced by Indian Railways during the financial year 2025-26 was:
e: As per the Press Information Bureau, Indian Railways produced 1,674 locomotives during the financial year 2025-26, along with 6,677 LHB coaches, under its Make in India push.

q: As per the Press Information Bureau, the total number of passengers carried by Indian Railways during the financial year 2025-26 was about:
e: As per the Press Information Bureau, Indian Railways carried about 741 crore passengers during the financial year 2025-26, with around 25,000 trains running daily.

q: The Ajni (Nagpur)-Pune Vande Bharat Express, flagged off in August 2025 and described as the longest-distance Vande Bharat service in the country at the time of its launch, connects Ajni with:
e: The Ajni (Nagpur)-Pune Vande Bharat Express, flagged off in August 2025 covering about 881 km, was the longest-distance Vande Bharat service in the country at the time of its launch, and it connects Ajni with Pune.

q: One of the Vande Bharat Express trains flagged off in August 2025 connects Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra with which city of Punjab?
e: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off in August 2025 between Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra and Amritsar connects Katra in Jammu and Kashmir with Amritsar in Punjab, improving access to the Vaishno Devi shrine.

q: In December 2017, Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) issued its maiden green bond, the proceeds of which were earmarked primarily for financing:

options.A: Metro rail projects in tier-2 cities
options.B: Dedicated Freight Corridor lines and public passenger transport projects

e: IRFC raised USD 500 million through its maiden 10-year green bond in December 2017, and its own release states the proceeds were to finance eligible green projects under Dedicated Freight Railway Lines and Public Passenger Transport.

q: An MoU signed in February 2026 proposes to form the Bharat Container Shipping Line (BCSL). Along with CONCOR, which organisation is a co-promoter of this venture with an equal stake?
e: The February 2026 MoU for Bharat Container Shipping Line lists CONCOR and Shipping Corporation of India with equal stakes of 30 per cent each, alongside port authorities and Sagarmala Finance Corporation.

q: Gateway Terminals India, which operates a container terminal at Jawaharlal Nehru Port (Nhava Sheva), is a joint venture of CONCOR with:
e: Gateway Terminals India, the container terminal operator at Jawaharlal Nehru Port, Nhava Sheva, is a joint venture of CONCOR with APM Terminals, the global terminal operating arm of the Maersk group.

q: Himalayan Terminals Private Limited, a joint venture involving CONCOR, operates a rail-linked inland container depot at Birgunj in which neighbouring country?
e: Himalayan Terminals Private Limited operates the rail-linked inland container depot at Birgunj, which is in Nepal and serves as the main dry port for Nepal trade through Raxaul.

q: The Centre for Advanced Maintenance Technology (CAMTECH) at Gwalior, which works on upgrading maintenance technologies and methodologies, functions under the administrative control of:
e: The Centre for Advanced Maintenance Technology at Gwalior works on modern maintenance technologies and functions under the administrative control of RDSO, the research and standards organisation of Indian Railways.

q: The Indian Railway Welfare Organisation (IRWO), which builds houses for serving and retired railway employees, was registered as a society in the year:
e: IRWO was registered as a society on 25 September 1989 under the Societies Registration Act, to build houses for serving and retired railway employees on a no profit no loss basis.

q: The Central Organisation for Railway Electrification (CORE) has its headquarters at:
e: The Central Organisation for Railway Electrification, set up to execute railway electrification projects, has its headquarters at Prayagraj in Uttar Pradesh.

q: The Sonnagar-Gomoh section of the Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor is being executed by DFCCIL through which mode?

options.D: Joint venture with the State Government

e: The Sonnagar-Gomoh section of the Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor is being executed by DFCCIL on a Public-Private Partnership basis, unlike most other DFC sections taken up through EPC contracts.

q: Bharatiya Rail Bijlee Company Limited (BRBCL), which operates the Nabinagar thermal power project in Bihar and supplies most of its power to the Railways, is a joint venture of the Ministry of Railways with:
e: Bharatiya Rail Bijlee Company Limited is a joint venture of the Ministry of Railways with NTPC Limited, and its Nabinagar thermal project in Bihar supplies most of its power to the Railways.

q: The National Land Monetization Corporation (NLMC), set up to monetise surplus land and building assets of CPSEs and other government agencies, functions under the administrative control of:

options.B: Department of Investment and Public Asset Management
options.C: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
options.D: Department of Public Enterprises, Ministry of Finance

e: The National Land Monetization Corporation functions under the administrative control of the Department of Public Enterprises in the Ministry of Finance, for monetising surplus land and buildings of CPSEs and government agencies.

q: Vadhavan Port Project Limited, the SPV developing the greenfield Vadhavan mega port in Maharashtra, is a joint venture of the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority with:
e: Vadhavan Port Project Limited, the SPV for the greenfield Vadhavan mega port in Maharashtra, is a joint venture of Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority with the Maharashtra Maritime Board.

q: The International Container Transshipment Terminal at Vallarpadam, Kochi, is operated by India Gateway Terminal (DP World Cochin). Which railway PSU is among the strategic partners in this terminal venture?
e: CONCOR is among the strategic partners in India Gateway Terminal, the DP World venture that operates the International Container Transshipment Terminal at Vallarpadam, Kochi.

q: Haryana Orbital Rail Corporation Limited (HORCL), which is executing the Haryana Orbital Rail Corridor, has which automobile manufacturer as one of its equity partners?
e: Haryana Orbital Rail Corporation Limited, executing the Haryana Orbital Rail Corridor, has Maruti Suzuki India Limited as one of its equity partners, supporting rail evacuation of finished vehicles.

q: The Golden Rock Railway Workshop at Tiruchirappalli was originally set up in 1897 at which place, before being shifted to Tiruchirappalli in 1928?
e: The Golden Rock workshop was originally set up in 1897 by South Indian Railway at Nagapattinam to maintain steam locomotives, and was later shifted to Tiruchirappalli, where work was completed in 1928.

q: The Rolling Stock Workshop of Western Railway at Dahod is located at:
e: Western Railway's Rolling Stock Workshop at Dahod is located at Freelandganj, the railway colony area of Dahod in Gujarat.

q: The EMU Workshop at Mahalaxmi in Mumbai, where periodic overhauling of Mumbai suburban EMU rakes is centralised, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The EMU Workshop at Mahalaxmi in Mumbai, where periodic overhauling of Mumbai suburban EMU rakes is centralised, functions under Western Railway.

q: The Asansol division of Eastern Railway, one of the oldest divisions of Indian Railways, was formed in the year:
e: Eastern Railway records state that Asansol Division was formed in 1925, when the East Indian Railway was split into divisions after the government took over its management.

q: The Malda division of Eastern Railway was formed in the year:
e: Eastern Railway records state that Malda Division was formed in 1984, after Asansol in 1925, Dhanbad in 1964 and Mughalsarai in 1975.

q: Which city is both the headquarters of South East Central Railway and the headquarters of a division of the same zone bearing the city's own name?
e: Bilaspur is the headquarters of South East Central Railway, and the same zone also has a division named Bilaspur with its headquarters in the same city.

q: After broad-gauge work was shifted away from it, the Motibagh Workshop at Nagpur continued to maintain the narrow-gauge rolling stock of which erstwhile railway?
e: After broad-gauge work moved away, the Motibagh Workshop at Nagpur continued maintaining narrow-gauge rolling stock of the erstwhile Satpura Railway, the narrow-gauge system centred on the Satpura region.

q: The engineering workshop at Manmad functions under which zonal railway?
e: The engineering workshop at Manmad, which supports track and engineering maintenance in the Bhusawal-Manmad region, functions under Central Railway.

q: The engineering workshop at Sabarmati functions under which zonal railway?
e: The engineering workshop at Sabarmati functions under Western Railway, as Sabarmati and Ahmedabad fall in the Ahmedabad division of Western Railway.

q: The first coach rolled out of the Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala, in the year:
e: Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala began production in September 1987 and rolled out its first coach on 31 March 1988.

q: The engineering workshop at Jalandhar functions under which zonal railway?
e: The engineering workshop at Jalandhar functions under Northern Railway, as Jalandhar lies in the Firozpur division of Northern Railway.

q: In railway establishment matters, 'SRPF' stands for:
e: In railway establishment matters SRPF stands for State Railway Provident Fund, the provident fund scheme applicable to railway employees.

q: In railway labour relations, 'PNM' stands for:
e: In railway labour relations PNM stands for Permanent Negotiating Machinery, the standing forum for negotiation between the Railway administration and recognised federations.

q: In Government of India staff matters, 'JCM' stands for:
e: In Government of India staff matters JCM stands for Joint Consultative Machinery, the scheme for joint consultation and compulsory arbitration for Central Government employees.

q: In railway pay and allowances, 'NDA' stands for:
e: In railway pay and allowances NDA stands for Night Duty Allowance, paid for duties performed during night hours.

q: In railway establishment matters, 'CEA' stands for:
e: In railway establishment matters CEA stands for Children Education Allowance, reimbursed for the education of children of government employees.

q: In railway establishment matters, 'FMA' stands for:
e: In railway establishment matters FMA stands for Fixed Medical Allowance, paid to pensioners and family pensioners not covered by CGHS or railway medical facilities for outdoor treatment.

q: In railway pay and allowances, 'OTA' stands for:
e: In railway pay and allowances OTA stands for Overtime Allowance, paid for work done beyond prescribed duty hours.

q: In pension matters, 'UPS', introduced for Central Government employees from 2025, stands for:
e: UPS stands for Unified Pension Scheme, introduced for Central Government employees from 2025 as an assured payout option under the pension framework.

q: In railway works and contracts, 'USSOR' stands for:
e: In railway works and contracts USSOR stands for Unified Standard Schedule of Rates, used for estimating and valuing railway works.

q: In project financing, 'VGF' stands for:
e: In project financing VGF stands for Viability Gap Funding, a capital grant to make economically justified but financially weak PPP projects viable.

q: In social security for employees, 'EDLI' stands for:
e: EDLI stands for Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance, the insurance scheme linked to provident fund deposits under the EPF framework.

q: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off in August 2025 from KSR Bengaluru gave direct Vande Bharat connectivity to which Karnataka city?
e: In August 2025 the Prime Minister flagged off the KSR Bengaluru-Belagavi Vande Bharat Express from Bengaluru, giving Belagavi direct Vande Bharat connectivity and covering 611 km in about 8.5 hours.

q: In September 2025, a breakthrough was achieved in the 4.88 km tunnel of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project between:
e: In September 2025 NHSRCL achieved a breakthrough in the 4.88 km bullet train tunnel between Ghansoli and Shilphata, part of the 21 km underground stretch from Bandra Kurla Complex to Shilphata.

q: Indian Railways' freight loading crossed 1 billion tonnes in FY 2025-26 by November 2025. The largest contributor to this freight loading was:
e: Coal remains the largest contributor to Indian Railways freight loading by volume, so it was also the largest contributor when loading crossed 1 billion tonnes in FY 2025-26 by November 2025.

q: Which State became the 24th State/UT to achieve 100% railway electrification, as announced in May 2025?
e: In May 2025 Gujarat became the 24th State or UT to achieve 100 per cent railway electrification, as announced during the inauguration of the Dahod electric locomotive factory.

q: India's first 9,000 HP electric locomotive, flagged off in May 2025, was manufactured at the locomotive plant located at:
e: India's first 9,000 HP electric locomotive, flagged off in May 2025, was manufactured at the locomotive plant at Dahod in Gujarat, set up with Siemens for making 1,200 such locomotives.

q: The Amrit Bharat Express flagged off in January 2026 connects Dibrugarh in Assam with which city?
e: In January 2026 the Dibrugarh-Gomti Nagar (Lucknow) Amrit Bharat Express was flagged off, connecting Dibrugarh in Assam with Gomti Nagar in Lucknow.

q: In February 2026, a new passenger train service was flagged off connecting Sairang, near Aizawl, with which city of Assam?
e: In February 2026 the new Sairang-Silchar passenger train was flagged off, connecting Sairang near Aizawl in Mizoram with Silchar in Assam's Barak Valley.

q: The Bhopal-Chopan Express, flagged off in February 2026, connects Bhopal with Chopan, which is located in which State?
e: The Bhopal-Chopan Express connects Bhopal with Chopan, a railway station in Sonbhadra district of Uttar Pradesh.

q: The Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat corridor, fully dedicated to the nation in February 2026, is unique because Namo Bharat (RRTS) trains and which other service operate on the same infrastructure, a first in India?
e: On the Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat corridor, Meerut Metro trains operate on the same RRTS infrastructure as Namo Bharat trains, a first-of-its-kind arrangement in India.

q: The Muzaffarpur-Charlapalli Amrit Bharat Express, flagged off in September 2025, connects Muzaffarpur with Charlapalli, which is located near which city?
e: Charlapalli is a satellite station near Hyderabad, so the Muzaffarpur-Charlapalli Amrit Bharat Express flagged off in September 2025 connects Muzaffarpur with the Hyderabad area.

q: The Bhubaneswar Metro Rail Corporation Limited, which is executing the first phase of the Bhubaneswar Metro from Biju Patnaik International Airport to Trisulia Square, is a fully owned company of the:
e: Bhubaneswar Metro Rail Corporation Limited, executing Phase 1 of the Bhubaneswar Metro from Biju Patnaik International Airport to Trisulia Square, is a fully owned company of the Government of Odisha.

q: Mumbai Metro One Private Limited (MMOPL), which operates Mumbai's Versova-Andheri-Ghatkopar Metro Line-1, is a joint venture in which the majority equity of 74 per cent is held by:
e: Mumbai Metro One Private Limited, operator of the Versova-Andheri-Ghatkopar Line-1, is a joint venture in which Reliance Infrastructure Limited holds the majority equity of 74 per cent.

q: Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited (HMRL), the special purpose vehicle set up as the nodal agency for facilitating the Hyderabad Metro Rail project, is a fully owned undertaking of the:
e: Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited, the nodal SPV for the Hyderabad Metro Rail project, is a fully owned undertaking of the Government of Telangana.

q: The Gurugram Metro Rail Limited (GMRL), a 50:50 joint venture of the Government of India and the Government of Haryana, is implementing the new Gurugram metro corridor between:

options.A: Millennium City Centre and Cyber City

e: Gurugram Metro Rail Limited, the 50:50 joint venture of the Government of India and the Government of Haryana, is implementing the new corridor between Millennium City Centre and Cyber City.

q: Hyderabad Airport Metro Limited (HAML), a special purpose vehicle jointly promoted by HMRL and HMDA, was set up to implement the Airport Express Metro Corridor in Hyderabad connecting the city with:

options.C: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport at Shamshabad

e: Hyderabad Airport Metro Limited was set up to implement the Airport Express Metro Corridor connecting the city with Rajiv Gandhi International Airport at Shamshabad.
